title: WonderMaps
description: A gridless exploration scene type for Foundry VTT v12. Build a map of circular areas linked by paths and forking crossroads. When the GM walks the party to a new area the map goes dark, rotates, and every player gets a compass arrow based on a blind Survival check. A blind Intelligence check decides whether they remember the adjacent areas they already visited. Areas can carry roll tables and hidden tracks with DCs.

recommends.reason: Optional: choose a SnapScene snapshot to restore when activating the scene linked to an area.
